title: VA Benefits & Claims — Health Care, Education, Home Loan, Pension, Survivors, Appeals
purpose: Reference for the full range of U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs benefits beyond disability rating: the claims and AMA appeals process, health care/PACT Act, GI Bill & VR&E education, the VA home loan, need-based pension, and survivor/burial benefits.
scope: VA.gov + 38 U.S.C./38 CFR. Reference only. Disability RATING criteria live in the companion va_disability_compensation pack.
freshness_expectation: Eligibility rules and dollar figures change (annual COLA, PACT Act expansions). Re-verify against VA.gov before quoting specifics.
